sources.findings: Nodes can return partial updates. Default per-key updates overwrite previous values. Compile the builder before invoking.

sources.title: Use the graph API: create a sequence of steps
sources.findings: Explicit add_node/add_edge supports sequential steps; add_sequence is an optional shorthand. This lesson intentionally teaches explicit edges.

sources.title: StateGraph.add_edge reference
sources.findings: A single-source directed edge waits for its source to complete before running its destination.
